mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stellar_user_points (user_id, total_points, available_points, frozen_points, total_earned, total_spent, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{totalPoints}, #{availablePoints}, #{frozenPoints}, #{totalEarned}, #{totalSpent}, #{version}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM stellar_user_points WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE stellar_user_points SET total_points = total_points + #{points}, available_points = available_points + #{points}, version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND version = #{oldVersion}
